Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — BookYourData and Kaspr share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

BookYourData and Kaspr share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose BookYourData only if your buying job matches “Real-time B2B contact database for building verified prospect lists with pay-as-you-go cre” rather than Kaspr's shape. Choose Kaspr only if your buying job matches “LinkedIn-centric EU/EMEA B2B contact capture (Chrome) — Free plan; Starter from $49/mo ann” rather than BookYourData's shape. Workflow advantage: BookYourData leans email-outreach; Kaspr leans data-enrichment. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.
